sentences.Hun låner ei norsk-italiensk ordbok og s: She borrows a Norwegian-Italian dictionary and sits in the reading room.
A girl comes over to her.
sentences.Nei, men jeg er italiensk. Jeg er au pai: No, but I'm Italian. I'm an au pair and I'm learning Norwegian.
sentences.Jeg er norsk, men jeg liker Italia!: I'm Norwegian, but I like Italy!
sentences.Nei, men jeg forstår litt. Pizza, pasta: No, but I understand a little. Pizza, pasta and mafia.
sentences.Jeg liker ikke norsk pizza. Hva heter du: I don't like Norwegian pizza. What's your name?
sentences.Jeg heter Viola. Hyggelig å hilse på deg: My name is Viola. Nice to meet you!
sentences.Når kom du til Norge?: When did you come to Norway?
sentences.Tusen takk! Hva gjør du på biblioteket?: Thank you so much! What are you doing at the library?
sentences.Jeg leser og gjør lekser. Jeg har test i: I'm reading and doing homework. I have a test tomorrow. Do you like Norway?
sentences.Ja, men jeg savner venner og familie. Je: Yes, but I miss my friends and family. I talk to them on Skype, and they call me.
sentences.Skal vi gå på kafé og drikke kaffe en da: Shall we go to a café and have coffee one day?
sentences.Å ja! Det vil jeg. Har du et telefonnumm: Oh yes! I'd like that. Do you have a phone number?
sentences.Unnskyld, kan du gjenta?: Sorry, can you say that again?
Thanks! I'll send you a text.
sentences.Viola møter ei norsk jente på biblioteke: Viola meets a Norwegian girl at the library.
sentences.Unnskyld, Håvard, hva betyr V2-regelen?: Excuse me, Håvard, what does the V2 rule mean?
sentences.V2-regelen betyr at verb har plass numme: The V2 rule means that the verb comes second in a sentence!
